articles.title: RBI intervention halts rupee's slide to record low, risks linger
articles.excerpt:
The Indian rupee struggles amid climbing oil prices and a weakening of Asian currencies. Despite the Reserve Bank of India's intervention, traders remain wary regarding the future of the currency. Many market players doubt that a central bank interest rate hike will stem capital flight, while escalating Brent crude prices raise alarms over possible Middle Eastern supply issues.

articles.excerpt:

articles.title: Nifty sinks to an 18-month low as rate fears bite
articles.excerpt:
A day after the central bank raised interest rates for the first time in more than three years, India's equity benchmark Nifty 50 plunged to an 18-month low on Thursday, breaching its previous 52-week trough amid a broad-based selloff.

The slide, into its ninth straight week now, has deepened concerns over further market losses, with surging oil prices threatening to keep inflation elevated, trigger more rate hikes and prolong the pain in the market.

The National Stock Exchange's Nifty 50 ended 1.64% lower at 22,231.80 on 8 October, its lowest closing level since 7 April 2025. The index had hit an intraday low of 22,179, a tad below its previous 52-week low of 22,182.

articles.title: Adani Group's Group CFO Jugeshinder Robbie Singh on recent market volatility: 'Mood is ephemeral; stone is eternal'
articles.excerpt:
As the Indian stock market reeled under severe selling pressure, with the headline indices falling to multi-month lows, Adani Group Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Jugeshinder Robbie Singh took to X to comment on the recent market volatility, highlighting the difference between short-term market sentiment and the underlying value of infrastructure assets.

Sharing his views on X, Singh said, “Mood is ephemeral; stone is eternal. While the crowd reacts to ticker noise, our infrastructure continues to weigh heavy and true.”

He further said, “In the end, substance always outlasts speculation. Look at the assets, not at the hyperventilating speculators.”

articles.title: Adani Group stocks tumble as market rout deepens; Adani Green, Adani Ent, others tank up to 10%

Despite receiving a long-term rating upgrade from CARE Ratings, investor confidence remained shaky. Other subsidiaries, including Adani Power and Adani Ports, also witnessed losses, underscoring the market's inherent volatility and investor unease regarding the current economic climate.

articles.title: India's 10-year yield hits Dec 2023 peak as US debt rout, oil spike hurt
articles.excerpt:
The Indian government bond market is feeling the heat from escalating US Treasury yields and climbing oil prices. Crude oil has surged, fueled by ongoing fears regarding supply disruptions in the Middle East. In light of this, the Reserve Bank of India has raised its policy rate, signaling a potential tightening of fiscal measures. As a result, forecasts suggest the benchmark 10-year bond yield could hit 7.40%.

The company’s cost of funds fell to 9.93 per cent during the quarter — the first time it has entered single-digit territory — declining 20 basis points from 10.13 per cent in Q1 FY27.
